culture_principles.name: Client/customer trust and impact
culture_principles.description: CIBC-style fit connects role skills and perspective to client progress, ambition, inclusion, and professional standards.

culture_principles.name: Risk, conduct, and integrity
culture_principles.description: Strong answers protect trust, conduct, controls, and risk boundaries while delivering outcomes.

culture_principles.name: Role-specific banking judgment
culture_principles.description: CIBC answers should show role alignment, client service, inclusion, and ethical professionalism.

hiring_signals.signal: Connects role-specific work to client/customer, colleague, community, or business impact.
Shows conduct, risk, escalation, and trust judgment in banking situations.
Uses concrete behavioral evidence rather than generic banking or brand interest.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Sales, speed, or delivery story that ignores suitability, risk, conduct, or client/customer trust.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Financial-services lens requires trust and conduct boundaries.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Generic bank or brand admiration without role-specific evidence.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Hiring evidence should connect candidate skills to role, client/customer impact, and culture.

interview_patterns.pattern: Behavioral interviews should test client/customer impact, conduct judgment, teamwork, and role alignment.
Risk, operations, technology, and corporate roles should test risk ownership, escalation, process improvement, and stakeholder communication.

honest_limits: This is a public-source and private-distillation draft lens and does not represent an official CIBC hiring standard.
Private materials authorized by the project owner are included only as distilled aggregate patterns, not raw article text or copied questions.
Role, level, region, line of business, recruiter, and hiring manager can materially change interview emphasis.
This v0.1 lens has static validation cases but is not approved for production screening until live answer backtesting and reviewer approval are complete.
This v0.2 lens has structured evidence records and an evidence audit, but is still not approved for production screening.
Public source URLs and private-material provenance must be reviewed before v1.0 approval.
